subtitle: A job application tracker your AI fills from job ads.
about: A note with applications, stages and next steps, plus interview prep and follow-ups. Paste a job ad into your AI to add it, or ask for interview questions before you meet.

ask.prompt: Set up the job hunt template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Save a job ad
slides.you: Here's the Finch Bikes ad. I want to apply by 18 Nov.
slides.ai: Added Finch Bikes as Saved, with Apply by 18 Nov as the next step.
slides.alt: Job hunt filled in, in Pinto Notes on a Mac

slides.label: Prep an interview
slides.you: I have a first interview with Tideway on Thursday. Help me prep.
slides.ai: Added three likely questions with talking points under Interview prep.

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
slides.alt: Job hunt as it starts, ready to fill in
